name: Alexa for Shopping
desc: Amazon's agentic shopping assistant in the Amazon app, from Rufus and Alexa+.
desc_zh: 亚马逊应用与网站内的购物智能体，由 Rufus 与 Alexa+ 合并而成。
solves: Comparing prices and reordering used to mean tab-hopping between search, reviews and your order history; one conversation now carries all of it.
solves_zh: 过去比价和补货要在搜索、评价和历史订单之间来回切换；现在一次对话就能把这些串起来。
best_for: You want to know whether a laptop was cheaper last Black Friday before you buy it today.
best_for_zh: 想在一台笔记本下单前，先确认它去年黑五是不是更便宜的时候。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — aboutamazon.com Artificial Intelligence news directory and the Alexa for Sho）。 This is the merged successor of Rufus and Alexa+ for shopping: the announcement says Amazon brings Rufus and Alexa+ together to create Alexa for Shopping. Rufus therefore has no separate ledger entry of its own. First published 2026-05-13, updated 2026-11-13 for international availability in 13 countries. No dedicated product page exists; the surface lives in the Amazon Shopping app and on amazon.com, and the homepage redirects to Amazon's Alexa storefront. 首次公开日期来源：https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/alexa-for-shopping-ai-assistant 官网未直接确认（redirect->https://www.amazon.com/b?node=210710065011）。
